verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: נֶ֚פֶשׁ כִּ֣י תֶחֱטָ֔א וּמָעֲלָ֥ה מַ֖עַל בַּיהוָ֑ה וְכִחֵ֨שׁ בַּעֲמִית֜וֹ בְּפִקָּד֗וֹן אֽוֹ־ בִתְשׂ֤וּמֶת יָד֙ א֣וֹ בְגָזֵ֔ל א֖וֹ עָשַׁ֥ק אֶת־ עֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš kî ṯe·ḥĕ·ṭā ū·mā·‘ă·lāh ma·‘al Yah·weh wə·ḵi·ḥêš ba·‘ă·mî·ṯōw bə·p̄iq·qā·ḏō·wn ’ōw- ḇiṯ·śū·meṯ yāḏ ’ōw ḇə·ḡā·zêl ’ōw ‘ā·šaq ’eṯ- ‘ă·mî·ṯōw
verses.literal: If someone sins and acts unfaithfully against the LORD by deceiving his neighbor in regard to a deposit or security entrusted to him or stolen . . . or if he extorts his neighbor
verses.literalPt: Se alguém pecar e cometer uma ofensa contra Jeová e se houver dolosamente com o seu próximo concernente a um depósito, ou penhor, ou roubo, ou tiver usado de extorsão para com o seu próximo;

verses.original: אֽוֹ־ מָצָ֧א אֲבֵדָ֛ה וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בָּ֖הּ וְנִשְׁבַּ֣ע עַל־ שָׁ֑קֶר עַל־ אַחַ֗ת מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הָאָדָ֖ם לַחֲטֹ֥א בָהֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- mā·ṣā ’ă·ḇê·ḏāh wə·ḵi·ḥeš bāh wə·niš·ba‘ ‘al- šā·qer ‘al- ’a·ḥaṯ mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh hā·’ā·ḏām la·ḥă·ṭō ḇā·hên·nāh
verses.literal: or finds lost property and lies about it and swears falsely or if he commits any such sin . . . . . . that . . . a man might commit
verses.literalPt: se tiver achado o que se perdeu, e nisso se houver dolosamente, e jurar falso; se fizer qualquer de todas as coisas que faz o homem, pecando nelas;

verses.original: וְהָיָה֮ כִּֽי־ יֶחֱטָ֣א וְאָשֵׁם֒ וְהֵשִׁ֨יב אֶת־ הַגְּזֵלָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּזָ֗ל א֤וֹ אֶת־ הָעֹ֙שֶׁק֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׁ֔ק א֚וֹ אֶת־ הַפִּקָּד֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָפְקַ֖ד אִתּ֑וֹ א֥וֹ אֶת־ הָאֲבֵדָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- ye·ḥĕ·ṭā wə·’ā·šêm wə·hê·šîḇ ’eṯ- hag·gə·zê·lāh ’ă·šer gā·zāl ’ōw ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·šeq ’ă·šer ‘ā·šāq ’ōw ’eṯ- hap·piq·qā·ḏō·wn ’ă·šer hā·p̄ə·qaḏ ’it·tōw ’ōw ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḇê·ḏāh ’ă·šer mā·ṣā
verses.literal: once he has sinned and becomes guilty he must return what . . . he has stolen or - taken by extortion or the deposit entrusted to him or the lost property he found
verses.literalPt: então, será que, se pecou e é culpado; restituirá o que roubou, ou o que extorquiu, ou o que lhe foi depositado, ou a coisa perdida que achou,

verses.original: א֠וֹ מִכֹּ֞ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִשָּׁבַ֣ע עָלָיו֮ לַשֶּׁקֶר֒ וְשִׁלַּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִׁתָ֖יו יֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֑יו לַאֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ יִתְּנֶ֖נּוּ בְּי֥וֹם אַשְׁמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw mik·kōl ’ă·šer- yiš·šā·ḇa‘ ‘ā·lāw laš·še·qer wə·šil·lam ’ō·ṯōw bə·rō·šōw wa·ḥă·mi·ši·ṯāw yō·sêp̄ ‘ā·lāw la·’ă·šer hū lōw yit·tə·nen·nū bə·yō·wm ’aš·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: or anything else about which he has sworn falsely He must make restitution in full add a fifth of the value and pay it to the owner . . . . . . on the day he acknowledges his guilt
verses.literalPt: ou qualquer coisa sobre que jurou falso; restituí-lo-á por inteiro e a isso acrescentará a quinta parte; a quem pertence, lho dará no dia em que se confessar culpado.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אֲשָׁמ֥וֹ יָבִ֖יא לַיהוָ֑ה אַ֣יִל תָּמִ֧ים מִן־ הַצֹּ֛אן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ לְאָשָׁ֖ם אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’ă·šā·mōw yā·ḇî Yah·weh ’a·yil tā·mîm min- haṣ·ṣōn bə·‘er·kə·ḵā lə·’ā·šām ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: Then he must bring to the priest his guilt offering to the LORD an unblemished ram of proper value from the flock
verses.literalPt: Como a sua oferta pela culpa trará a Jeová um carneiro sem defeito, tirado do rebanho, conforme a tua avaliação; trá-lo-á ao sacerdote para uma oferta pela culpa.

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֑וֹ עַל־ אַחַ֛ת מִכֹּ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לְאַשְׁמָ֥ה בָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw hak·kō·hên lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·nis·laḥ lōw ‘al- ’a·ḥaṯ mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh lə·’aš·māh ḇāh
verses.literal: In this way the priest will make atonement for him before the LORD and he will be forgiven for anything . . . he may have done to incur guilt
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote fará expiação por ele diante de Jeová, e ele será perdoado em qualquer uma de todas as coisas que faz o homem, tornando-se nelas culpado.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: צַ֤ו אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָעֹלָ֑ה הִ֣וא הָעֹלָ֡ה עַל֩ מוֹקְדָ֨ה עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ כָּל־ הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ עַד־ הַבֹּ֔קֶר וְאֵ֥שׁ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ תּ֥וּקַד בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw lê·mōr zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hā·‘ō·lāh hî hā·‘ō·lāh ‘al mō·wq·ḏāh ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ kāl- hal·lay·lāh ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer wə·’êš ham·miz·bê·aḥ tū·qaḏ bōw
verses.literal: Command Aaron and his sons . . . that this is the law of the burnt offering The burnt offering . . . is to remain on the hearth of the altar all night until morning and the fire must be kept burning on the altar
verses.literalPt: Ordena a Arão e a seus filhos, dizendo: Esta é a lei do holocausto: o holocausto ficará na lareira do altar a noite toda até pela manhã, e nesse lugar se conservará aceso o fogo do altar.

verses.original: וְלָבַ֨שׁ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדּ֣וֹ בַ֗ד וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־ בַד֮ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ עַל־ בְּשָׂרוֹ֒ וְהֵרִ֣ים אֶת־ הַדֶּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֥ל הָאֵ֛שׁ אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֖ה עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְשָׂמ֕וֹ אֵ֖צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·ḇaš hak·kō·hên mid·dōw ḇaḏ ū·miḵ·nə·sê- ḇaḏ yil·baš ‘al- bə·śā·rōw wə·hê·rîm ’eṯ- had·de·šen ’ă·šer tō·ḵal hā·’êš ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·śā·mōw ’ê·ṣel ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: And the priest shall put on his linen robe and linen . . . undergarments . . . . . . and he shall remove from the altar the ashes of the burnt offering . . . that the fire has consumed and place them beside it
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote vestirá a sua veste de linho e vestirá as calças sobre a sua carne; levantará a cinza a que foi reduzido o holocausto sobre o altar e a porá junto ao altar.

verses.original: וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְלָבַ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְהוֹצִ֤יא אֶת־ הַדֶּ֙שֶׁן֙ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה אֶל־ מָק֖וֹם טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·šaṭ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·lā·ḇaš bə·ḡā·ḏîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- had·de·šen ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh ’el- mā·qō·wm ṭā·hō·wr
verses.literal: Then he must take off his garments put on other clothes and carry the ashes outside the camp . . . to a ceremonially clean place
verses.literalPt: Depois, despirá as suas vestes e, vestido com outras, levará a cinza para fora do arraial a um lugar limpo.

verses.original: וְהָאֵ֨שׁ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ תּֽוּקַד־ בּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וּבִעֵ֨ר עָלֶ֧יהָ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עֵצִ֖ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָרַ֤ךְ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ הָֽעֹלָ֔ה וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖יהָ חֶלְבֵ֥י הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’êš ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ tū·qaḏ- bōw lō ṯiḵ·beh ū·ḇi·‘êr ‘ā·le·hā hak·kō·hên ‘ê·ṣîm bab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer wə·‘ā·raḵ ‘ā·le·hā hā·‘ō·lāh wə·hiq·ṭîr ‘ā·le·hā ḥel·ḇê haš·šə·lā·mîm
verses.literal: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning it must not be extinguished Every morning . . . the priest is to add wood to the fire arrange the burnt offering on it and burn the fat portions of the peace offerings on it
verses.literalPt: O fogo sobre o altar se conservará aceso; não se apagará. O sacerdote nele acenderá lenha todos os dias pela manhã; sobre ele porá em ordem o holocausto e sobre ele queimará a gordura das ofertas pacíficas.

verses.original: אֵ֗שׁ תָּמִ֛יד תּוּקַ֥ד עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לֹ֥א תִכְבֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êš tā·mîḏ tū·qaḏ ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ lō ṯiḵ·ḇɛh
verses.literal: The fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually it must not be extinguished
verses.literalPt: O fogo se conservará aceso sobre o altar continuamente; não se apagará.

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַמִּנְחָ֑ה הַקְרֵ֨ב אֹתָ֤הּ בְּנֵֽי־ אַהֲרֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ פְּנֵ֖י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ tō·w·raṯ ham·min·ḥāh haq·rêḇ ’ō·ṯāh bə·nê- ’a·hă·rōn lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’el- pə·nê ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Now this is the law of the grain offering Aaron’s sons shall present it before the LORD in front of the altar
verses.literalPt: Esta á a lei da oferta de cereais: os filhos de Arão a oferecerão na presença de Jeová, diante do altar.

verses.original: וְהֵרִ֨ים מִמֶּ֜נּוּ בְּקֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסֹּ֤לֶת הַמִּנְחָה֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַלְּבֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ רֵ֧יחַ נִיחֹ֛חַ אַזְכָּרָתָ֖הּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·rîm mim·men·nū bə·qum·ṣōw mis·sō·leṯ ham·min·ḥāh ū·miš·šam·nāh wə·’êṯ kāl- hal·lə·ḇō·nāh ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·min·ḥāh wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·aḥ rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest is to remove a handful of fine flour and olive oil together with all the frankincense from the grain offering and burn the memorial portion on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Um deles tomará dela um punhado, a saber, da flor de farinha da oferta de cereais e do azeite da mesma, e tomará todo o incenso que estiver sobre a oferta de cereais, e os queimará sobre o altar por suave cheiro, como o memorial da oferta a Jeová.

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֣רֶת מִמֶּ֔נָּה יֹאכְל֖וּ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו מַצּ֤וֹת תֵּֽאָכֵל֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֔שׁ בַּחֲצַ֥ר אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד יֹאכְלֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·w·ṯe·reṯ mim·men·nāh yō·ḵə·lū ’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw maṣ·ṣō·wṯ tê·’ā·ḵêl bə·mā·qō·wm qā·ḏōš ba·ḥă·ṣar ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ yō·ḵə·lū·hā
verses.literal: Aaron and his sons are to eat the remainder It must be eaten without leaven in a holy place they are to eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: O que ficar da oferta, isso comerão Arão e seus filhos; comer-se-á sem fermento num santo lugar; no átrio da tenda da revelação o comerão.

verses.original: לֹ֤א תֵאָפֶה֙ חָמֵ֔ץ חֶלְקָ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֹתָ֖הּ מֵאִשָּׁ֑י קֹ֤דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים֙ הִ֔וא כַּחַטָּ֖את וְכָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯê·’ā·p̄eh ḥā·mêṣ ḥel·qām nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·ṯāh mê·’iš·šāy qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hî ka·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·ḵā·’ā·šām
verses.literal: It must not be baked with leaven I have assigned it as their portion of My food offerings It is most holy like the sin offering and the guilt offering
verses.literalPt: Levedado não se cozerá. Como a sua porção das minhas ofertas queimadas lho tenho dado; coisa santíssima é, como a oferta pelo pecado e como a oferta pela culpa.

verses.original: כָּל־ זָכָ֞ר בִּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ יֹֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה חָק־ עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּ֥ע בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- zā·ḵār biḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn yō·ḵă·len·nāh ḥāq- ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh kōl ’ă·šer- yig·ga‘ bā·hem yiq·dāš
verses.literal: Any male among the sons of Aaron may eat it This is a permanent portion from the food offerings to the LORD for the generations to come Anything that touches them will become holy
verses.literalPt: Todo macho entre os filhos de Arão comerá dela, como de uma coisa que, das ofertas queimadas, de Jeová, vos é devida para sempre nas vossas gerações; todo o que tocar nelas será santo.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: זֶ֡ה קָרְבַּן֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו אֲשֶׁר־ יַקְרִ֣יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ עֲשִׂירִ֨ת הָאֵפָ֥ה סֹ֛לֶת מִנְחָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מַחֲצִיתָ֣הּ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָ֖הּ בָּעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: zeh qā·rə·ban ’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw ’ă·šer- yaq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh bə·yō·wm him·mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw ‘ă·śî·riṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh sō·leṯ min·ḥāh tā·mîḏ ma·ḥă·ṣî·ṯāh bab·bō·qer ū·ma·ḥă·ṣî·ṯāh bā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: This is the offering that Aaron and his sons must present to the LORD on the day he is anointed a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering half of it in the morning and half in the evening
verses.literalPt: Esta é a oblação de Arão e de seus filhos, a qual oferecerão a Jeová no dia em que for ungido: oferecerão para sempre a décima parte de um efa de flor de farinha como uma oferta de cereais, metade dela pela manhã, e metade à tarde.

verses.original: עַֽל־ מַחֲבַ֗ת בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן תֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה מֻרְבֶּ֣כֶת תְּבִיאֶ֑נָּה תֻּפִינֵי֙ מִנְחַ֣ת פִּתִּ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- ma·ḥă·ḇaṯ baš·še·men tê·‘ā·śeh mur·be·ḵeṯ tə·ḇî·’en·nāh tu·p̄î·nê min·ḥaṯ pit·tîm taq·rîḇ rê·aḥ- nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: It shall be prepared with oil on a griddle you are to bring it well-kneaded and present it as a grain offering broken in pieces a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Numa assadeira se preparará com azeite; depois de estar embebida, a trarás; em pedaços cozidos oferecerás a oferta de cereais por suave cheiro a Jeová.

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַמָּשִׁ֧יחַ תַּחְתָּ֛יו מִבָּנָ֖יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ חָק־ עוֹלָ֕ם לַיהוָ֖ה כָּלִ֥יל תָּקְטָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hên ham·mā·šî·aḥ taḥ·tāw mib·bā·nāw ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯāh ḥāq- ‘ō·w·lām Yah·weh kā·lîl tā·qə·ṭār
verses.literal: The priest who is one of Aaron’s sons and will be anointed to take his place is to prepare it As a permanent portion for the LORD it must be burned completely
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote ungido que dentre seus filhos lhe suceder a oferecerá; por estatuto perpétuo será de todo queimada a Jeová.

verses.original: וְכָל־ מִנְחַ֥ת כֹּהֵ֛ן כָּלִ֥יל תִּהְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl min·ḥaṯ kō·hên kā·lîl tih·yeh lō ṯê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: Every grain offering for a priest shall be burned completely it is not to be eaten
verses.literalPt: Toda a oferta de cereais do sacerdote será totalmente queimada; não se comerá.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse ainda mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַֽחַטָּ֑את בִּמְק֡וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ תִּשָּׁחֵ֨ט הָעֹלָ֜ה תִּשָּׁחֵ֤ט הַֽחַטָּאת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw lê·mōr zōṯ tō·w·raṯ ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer tiš·šā·ḥêṭ hā·‘ō·lāh tiš·šā·ḥêṭ ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hî
verses.literal: Tell . . . Aaron . . . and his sons . . . that this is the law of the sin offering In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered the sin offering shall be slaughtered before the LORD it is most holy . . .
verses.literalPt: Fala a Arão e a seus filhos: Esta é a lei da oferta pelo pecado: ela será morta diante de Jeová no lugar em que é morto o holocausto; coisa santíssima é.

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַֽמְחַטֵּ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ יֹאכֲלֶ֑נָּה בְּמָק֤וֹם קָדֹשׁ֙ תֵּֽאָכֵ֔ל בַּחֲצַ֖ר אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ham·ḥaṭ·ṭê ’ō·ṯāh yō·ḵă·len·nāh bə·mā·qō·wm qā·ḏōš tê·’ā·ḵêl ba·ḥă·ṣar ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The priest who offers it shall eat it it must be eaten in a holy place in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote que a oferece pelo pecado a comerá; num lugar santo se comerá, no átrio da tenda da revelação.

verses.original: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּ֥ע בִּבְשָׂרָ֖הּ יִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִזֶּ֤ה מִדָּמָהּ֙ עַל־ הַבֶּ֔גֶד אֲשֶׁר֙ יִזֶּ֣ה עָלֶ֔יהָ תְּכַבֵּ֖ס בְּמָק֥וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kōl ’ă·šer- yig·ga‘ biḇ·śā·rāh yiq·dāš wa·’ă·šer yiz·zeh mid·dā·māh ‘al- hab·be·ḡeḏ ’ă·šer yiz·zeh ‘ā·le·hā tə·ḵab·bês bə·mā·qō·wm qā·ḏōš
verses.literal: Anything that touches its flesh will become holy and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment you must wash it . . . . . . in a holy place
verses.literalPt: Tudo o que tocar a carne da oferta será santo; quando algum vestido se aspergir do sangue dela, num lugar santo lavarás o que assim se aspergiu.

verses.original: וּכְלִי־ חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּבֻשַּׁל־ בּ֖וֹ יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְאִם־ בִּכְלִ֤י נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ בֻּשָּׁ֔לָה וּמֹרַ֥ק וְשֻׁטַּ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·lî- ḥe·reś ’ă·šer tə·ḇuš·šal- bōw yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·’im- biḵ·lî nə·ḥō·šeṯ buš·šā·lāh ū·mō·raq wə·šuṭ·ṭap̄ bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: The clay pot in which the sin offering is boiled must be broken if it is boiled in a bronze pot the pot must be scoured and rinsed with water
verses.literalPt: Mas o vaso de barro em que foi cozida será quebrado; se for cozida num vaso de cobre, será esfregado e lavado em água.

verses.original: כָּל־ זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכַ֣ל אֹתָ֑הּ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- zā·ḵār bak·kō·hă·nîm yō·ḵal ’ō·ṯāh qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hî
verses.literal: Any male among the priests may eat it it is most holy
verses.literalPt: Todo homem entre os sacerdotes comerá dela; coisa santíssima é.

verses.original: וְכָל־ חַטָּ֡את אֲשֶׁר֩ יוּבָ֨א מִדָּמָ֜הּ אֶל־ אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֣א תֵאָכֵ֑ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer yū·ḇā mid·dā·māh ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lə·ḵap·pêr baq·qō·ḏeš lō ṯê·’ā·ḵêl bā·’êš tiś·śā·rêp̄
verses.literal: But no sin offering may be eaten if its blood has been brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place . . . it must be burned
verses.literalPt: Não se comerá nenhuma oferta pelo pecado, da qual uma parte do sangue é trazida para dentro da tenda da revelação, a fim de fazer expiação no santo lugar; será queimada com fogo.
